title: Analects
subtitle: Sayings and actions associated with Confucius and his disciples
timeLabel: Compilation and circulation: Warring States to Han ranges
shortSummary: The Analects preserves early Confucian discussions of ethics, education and politics through sayings and encounters associated with Confucius and his disciples.
curatorialDescription: The Analects is not a text outside compilation history. Its transmission, commentaries and use in state education gave it new institutional contexts over time.
researchNote: Formation, editions and commentary relationships will be refined through the text-version and commentary data model.
